relevant_laws.quote: Whenever signals are placed over the individual lanes of a highway, the signals indicate, and apply to drivers of vehicles, as follows: A red “X” symbol means a driver facing the signal must not enter or drive in any lane over which the red signal is shown.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct overhead lane signal facing bus
relevant_laws.notes: The one-way multilane cell can support the branch; official device and highway source review remain required.
